notes:
Summary: engineering-led POC for large-scale code search + reranking. Primary goal is to replace in-house vector stack (OpenSearch + custom reranker) with a single inference platform that lowers TCO and reduces ops complexity. Key ask: handle 40–60M embeddings, daily re-index cadence for active repos, sub-200ms rerank latency at 95th percentile for developer flows.

Recent context / quotes: 
- "We need predictable cost — last quarter vector infra spiked unexpectedly." — Head of Platform.
- Security: SSO + SCIM mandatory, audit trails for all calls, field-level redaction for secrets.
- Legal: must review DPA and provide data residency attestation for EU projects.

Technical requirements (short):
- Index size target: 40–60M vectors (embeddings dim: 1024 planned, eval also with 768).
- Re-index cadence: nightly full ingest for changed repos, incremental continuous ingest for commits. Expect high churn for active microservices (hundreds of repos).
- QPS/Throughput: burst to 250 qps; steady state 80–120 qps for search traffic, many multi-stage flows (retrieval -> rerank -> code-snippet assemble).
- Latency SLOs: retrieval < 120ms, cross-encoder rerank end-to-end <200ms (95th).
- Cost target: infra + inference cost per query target $0.002–$0.005. Prefers deduped/compact embedding profiles and KV caching to meet cost goals.
- Model preferences: open-embeddings (in-house fine-tune on code) or smaller hosted embedding endpoint; cross-encoder reranker ideally a quantized LLM variant on Dedicated GPUs.
- Fallbacks: need routing to lower-cost region/model when Dedicated capacity saturated. Must preserve semantics for legal/regulatory routes.

POC acceptance criteria: 
- Ingest 10M representative vectors within 48 hours and serve 100 qps with <220ms 95th latency.
- 7-day stress run demonstrating cost per query within 25% of target and no more than 2% error rate on rerank recall test-sets.
- Security checklist: SSO flow validated (IdP SAML), audit logs enabled and exported, KMS integration tested for model key wrapping.

Operational notes / obs for AE/SE:
- Team is infra-heavy (Platform Eng + Search SRE), expect deep questions on batching, KV cache TTLs, prefix caching strategies.
- They will want examples of autoscaler behavior under burst loads and rollback plan when reranker nodes overload.
- Interested in Optimize suggestions: quantization profiles, batching configs, and recommendations for model-size vs throughput tradeoffs.

Links & artifacts: proposal v2 on Drive, security FAQ, Fireflies notes from discovery and architecture call.

Short-term asks from Obsidian:
- Provide sample architecture diagram for Private/VPC deployment w/ dedicated GPU pool.
- Cost model estimate for 50M vectors with daily reindex and 150 qps baseline.
- Run a 1-week perf POC with a small Dedicated cluster and instrumentation (tracing + token-level cost).
